**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

One photo-to-animation workflow: the 267×716 output has eight GIF frames. The input photo stays link-only because its original contains location metadata; only the animation is archived. The source reports cable removal, background cleanup and reduced resolution. Reported generation time is not independently benchmarked.
